question: Can Elm promise all copies of a10 and a11 will be gone within 35 days, and can a restored snapshot make either attachment searchable again?

criteria.instruction: Normal backups retain 35 days, but held snapshots containing covered material remain until case authority resolves the hold; the hold snapshot inventory is incomplete. Recipient exports are outside recall control. A restore must apply current expiry/hold state before reads and cannot revive these expired attachments.
Cite backup contract and policy or inventory. Distinguish active-store deletion, immutable backup retention and untracked recipient copies.
Decline the all-copies/35-day guarantee and any exact global erasure date. Do not assert snapshots or recipient copies were already deleted or all inventoried.
